resources.string: Shown while Pocket Money Pal runs, so phones can reach this device.
Parents’ phones connect to this device. Tap to open the kids’ screen.
Pocket Money Pal couldn’t start.\n\nIf another copy is running, close it, then try again.
Enter this device’s screen lock to continue.
\n\nThis device has no screen lock, so anyone using it can do this, kids included. To stop that, set a screen lock in Android’s Settings.

Every paired phone stops working with Pocket Money Pal straight away, including any that are lost. Nothing else changes: quests, points and money stay as they are.\n\nTo pair a phone again, open the Pocket Money Pal: Parent app on it and scan the code on the kids’ screen. On an iPhone, scan it with the camera and open it in Safari. Then pair any other phones from that one.
The kids’ screen now shows a QR code. Scan it with a phone to pair it again.
